title: Doomsday
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, the office implements a new accountability system called the 'accountability booster' designed to track mistakes and enforce consequences, causing tension and resistance among employees. Dwight takes charge of the system, leading to conflicts over its operation, including an automated email that threatens the staff's jobs. Jim and Robert engage in a squash game amidst the crisis, while Pam and Erin try to reason with Dwight at his home. Ultimately, Dwight stops the doomsday device, saving the office from disaster. Meanwhile, workplace relationships and office traditions provide lighter moments throughout the episode.

main_threads.thread: Implementation and impact of the accountability booster system in the office, including employee reactions, mistakes tracked, and the threat of a doomsday device.
